description: Scoring, report, and workflow evals using mock data. Run with: claude -p "$(cat evals/scenarios/<N>.md)" --allowedTools Read,Write. Scenarios 09–12 are focused decision evaluations, not full reports.
output_path_convention: Test-harness exception: scenarios intentionally instruct the report to be written to evals/outputs/NN-<name>-report.md for deterministic collection by the eval harness. This overrides report-generation.md, which mandates EKS-Upgrade-Assessment-<cluster>-<date>.md at the workspace root for real (non-eval) runs. evals/outputs/ is gitignored.

evals.name: clean-cluster-ready
evals.expected_output: Score 100%, rating READY, no blockers, all required report sections present

assertions.name: score_is_100
assertions.check: score == 100

assertions.name: rating_ready
assertions.check: report rating matches regex '(?<!NOT )READY' (anchored: 'NOT READY' must NOT satisfy this)

assertions.name: no_blockers
assertions.check: Blockers section says 'No blockers identified'

assertions.name: all_sections_present
assertions.check: report contains all required headings

evals.name: hard-blocker-karpenter
evals.expected_output: Score 59% (hard-blocker cap), rating NOT READY, Karpenter flagged as blocker. Upgrade Plan orders control plane first, then data plane, then add-ons; the conditional Karpenter step is upgrade-first (Karpenter is not an ordering exception — it is a compatibility prerequisite, brought to a target-compatible version before the control plane).

assertions.name: score_capped_59
assertions.check: score == 59

assertions.name: rating_not_ready
assertions.check: report rating contains 'NOT READY'

assertions.name: karpenter_in_blockers
assertions.check: Blockers section mentions Karpenter

assertions.name: karpenter_version_detected
assertions.check: report contains '0.37'

assertions.name: upgrade_order_correct
assertions.check: Upgrade Plan is control-plane-first (control plane before data plane and add-ons), AND the conditional Karpenter step runs upgrade-first (Karpenter upgraded before the control plane, as a compatibility prerequisite rather than an ordering exception)

evals.name: hard-blocker-degraded-addon

assertions.name: score_capped_59

assertions.name: rating_not_ready
assertions.check: report contains 'NOT READY'

assertions.name: ebs_csi_in_blockers
assertions.check: Blockers section mentions ebs-csi or EBS CSI

assertions.name: degraded_mentioned

assertions.name: rating_good

assertions.name: no_hard_blocker_override

assertions.name: both_subnet_warnings_not_blocker

evals.name: denied-read-category-unassessed
evals.expected_output: One category (Deprecated APIs) had its backing read denied (403), so it is reported UNKNOWN / not-scored: listed in ## Unassessed, excluded from the score sum (NOT scored 0), and the headline carries the '(partial — N categories unassessed)' marker and is capped below READY. Assessed remainder scores 98 (sole deduction: subnet-aaa low-IP warning +2 under Node Readiness), but the partial marker prevents a READY rating.

assertions.name: deprecated_apis_unassessed
assertions.check: ## Unassessed section lists the Deprecated APIs category with the denied/403 read as the reason

assertions.name: unassessed_excluded_from_sum
assertions.check: Deprecated APIs contributes NO row to the Master Finding List Pts sum and NO deduction — it is excluded, not scored 0

assertions.name: headline_partial_marker
assertions.check: headline band contains a '(partial' unassessed marker, e.g. '(partial — 1 category unassessed)'

assertions.name: capped_below_ready
assertions.check: report rating contains 'GOOD' (a capped partial assessment is pinned to exactly GOOD, not READY and not an over-conservative FAIR/RISKY band)

assertions.name: assessed_remainder_98
assertions.check: assessed-remainder arithmetic score == 98 (100 - 2 for the single low-IP subnet warning)

evals.name: cluster-identity-binding
evals.expected_output: Wrong or unverified connection halts before Kubernetes reads; a unique endpoint-matching context is pinned; ambiguous credentials require selection; denied reads on a verified cluster retain partial-assessment behavior.

assertions.name: wrong_cluster_halts
assertions.check: Case 1 halts without Kubernetes reads, configuration mutation, or readiness score; a matching display name is insufficient

assertions.name: unique_context_pinned
assertions.check: Case 2 selects operations-alias and uses explicit --context for all subsequent kubectl calls

assertions.name: ambiguous_context_asks
assertions.check: Case 3 requests credential/context selection instead of choosing admin or reader

assertions.name: mcp_identity_independent
assertions.check: Case 4 halts for unverifiable MCP binding even though local context matches

assertions.name: permission_failure_partial
assertions.check: Case 5 continues only as a caveated partial assessment; DevOps runtime does so autonomously

evals.name: managed-addon-default-not-latest
evals.expected_output: A/B/D/E/F COMPATIBLE (0); C UPDATE_RECOMMENDED (1); G INCOMPATIBLE optional (3, no cap); H Unassessed/not-scored. No downgrade based on default mismatch.

assertions.name: newer_equal_missing_default
assertions.check: A, B, D, E, F are target COMPATIBLE, 0 pts, no default-mismatch downgrade

assertions.name: behind_default
assertions.check: C is UPDATE_RECOMMENDED, 1 pt; do not recommend installation before verifying the candidate on current

assertions.name: complete_set_absence
assertions.check: G is optional INCOMPATIBLE, 3 pts, no hard-blocker cap

assertions.name: pagination_failure
assertions.check: H is UNKNOWN/not-scored and Unassessed, not INCOMPATIBLE or a clean pass

assertions.name: numeric_build_order
assertions.check: D treats eksbuild.10 as newer than eksbuild.9 and includes page 2

assertions.name: matching_compatibility_entry
assertions.check: E uses the 1.35 default flag, not the 1.34 flag

evals.name: current-target-transition
evals.expected_output: Alpha uses verified 2.5 bridge with documented CRD-first migration; beta transition unresolved; gamma current-only support concern without outage claim or extra deduction; delta and denied current lookup remain explicitly unassessed.

assertions.name: bridge_candidate
assertions.check: Alpha recommends 2.5 before control plane with CRD migration; never 3.0 before 1.35

assertions.name: no_bridge_no_invention
assertions.check: Beta has no verified pre-upgrade candidate or fabricated install command; migration review required

assertions.name: current_only_concern
assertions.check: Gamma reports existing unsupported 1.34 combination, target COMPATIBLE 0 pts, no invented outage or hard blocker

assertions.name: missing_current_evidence
assertions.check: Delta current compatibility is UNKNOWN and Unassessed; known target compatibility retained

assertions.name: denied_current_read
assertions.check: Case 5 lists current compatibility read in Unassessed without discarding target evidence or presenting complete READY

evals.name: pdb-drain-eligibility
evals.expected_output: Recovering, restrictive, percentage contribute 2 each; paused, other-group, exempt 0; stale/inconsistent Unassessed. PDB raw subtotal 6, medium cap yields Category 6 subtotal 4. Unspecified scope is unassessed.

assertions.name: empty_and_outside_scope
assertions.check: paused and other-group contribute no drain-risk deduction

assertions.name: health_vs_configuration
assertions.check: recovering gets health-recovery advice; restrictive and percentage get owner policy/maintenance review; each contributes 2 pts

assertions.name: unhealthy_eviction_exemption
assertions.check: exempt contributes 0 because only unhealthy AlwaysAllow pod is on affected node

assertions.name: unknown_data
assertions.check: stale and inconsistent are Unassessed/not-scored, not clean passes

assertions.name: subtotal
assertions.check: raw PDB subtotal 6; Category 6 medium subtotal capped at 4; no hard-blocker cap

assertions.name: unknown_scope
assertions.check: recovering with unspecified scope is potential risk/Unassessed, not a proven scored drain obstruction
